name: AT-rich interaction domain 3C
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ARID3C encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 3C. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and macrophage differentiation.

function.text: ARID3C encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 3C. It is a transcription factor involved in monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation. It forms a complex with NPM1 to translocate to the nucleus, acting as a transcription factor that promotes the expression of the genes involved in macrophage differentiation, such as STAT3, STAT1 and JUNB.
